# MAD Audit 2026-08-12 - Verified Findings

Baseline: all 3,626 tests green (67 s on-device). 149 findings filed; after adversarial verification: **8 high, 35 med, ~104 low, 2 refuted outright**, many re-rated down with evidence. Prior-audit debt (2026-06-15 + 2026-06-25): all HIGH/MED verified fixed except ONE (Eden/Citron type=0, below).

## HIGH (8)

1. **Local backups contain no saves for 8 emulators.** `deck-backup.sh:306,405,430` tars the `~/Emulation/saves` symlink hub without dereferencing; newest real archive holds 21 zero-byte links, zero save bytes for Dolphin/Ryujinx/flycast/PPSSPP/shadPS4/azahar/Cemu/xenia (PCSX2 memcards + OpenBOR are real files and fine). Cloud DOES follow links (protected as of 2026-08-10). Fix: saves category as its own dereferencing tar step (NOT whole-archive `-h`: Cemu/xenia links point into ROM trees); then one restore drill.
2. **Eden + Citron Switch state is in NO backup tier**: `~/.config/{eden,citron}` + keys/nand-saves/mods slices of `~/.local/share/{eden,citron}` (51 MB saves, prod/title keys). Add to EMU_ITEMS precious slices only (exclude shader/dump).
3. **6.4 MB theme art untracked and in zero backups**: 7 new system dirs + 21 panel icons in `~/ES-DE/themes/pixel-es-de` (cloud excludes themes/**). Fix: commit + push the theme repo.
4. **Update supply chain too trusting**: mmadalone/mad is public, main/deck-patches unprotected, on-device PAT is ADMIN-scoped, updater integrity is MD5 published in the same latest_release.json it protects, no signature. Fix: branch protection + fine-grained read-only PAT + SHA-256 published and verified by ApplicationUpdater. (CI double-publish race REFUTED: concurrency group serializes; only deck-patches source ships.)
5. ~~**Six C++ backup pages are one page pasted six times**~~ (System/Controllers/Esde ~95% identical; Bios/Emu 89%; BiosFiles/EmuFiles 75%; attachRunStream x6). Proven drift: Sinden install stream lacks the {closed} branch (panel auto-restart bounds it). **BUILT + REVIEWED 2026-08-13 as phase 4b** (see suggested-order item 4); five pages folded, BackupRestore deliberately left out. NOTE: C++ has zero automated tests; review + on-screen pass is the only gate.
6. **Citron/Eden python clones with proven drift**: 6 module pairs 82-98% identical (~1,000 dup lines); citron_pg_input_cmds.py:136 missed Eden's empty-[Controls] fix (junk file, inert). Fix: backport + test first, then fold pairs into shared engines per the existing yuzu_pergame/yuzu_profile_cmds pattern (RPC names unchanged).
7. **Game launch pays ~10 python interpreter starts, 1.5-2.0 s overhead** (5-6 full router loads at 187-253 ms; measured twice independently). Fix: batched launch-info RPC + lazy router imports + bash-only hook-04 gate + cached splash (ffmpeg 165 ms/launch). Care: quit-combo vs sinden pass different ROM escaping.
8. **Backup compression 21.7x slower than needed**: single-thread gzip; pigz can never exist on SteamOS; zstd -T0 ships in the base image and was benchmarked 21.7x faster at identical size. Care: deck-restore.sh:58 glob + verify path must learn .tar.zst in the SAME change.

## Phase 5 (hygiene) - what shipped, 2026-08-13

**Code.** Eden/Citron controller `type=` preserved at both launch writers (the last open finding from
the June audits) plus the two further writers the review then found, so the June item is closed for
real this time; `es_find_rules` writes atomically; the backup destination/format preferences moved
out of the git clone into `storage/control-panel/backup-prefs.json` with a read-old-write-new
migration; `lib/inifile.py` no longer goes blind on a CRLF section header; a cloud RESTORE is now
frozen during gameplay whatever the "backup during gameplay" toggle says, at all three sites a job
can start; `game-start/20-cloud-pause.sh` renamed to `01-cloud-pause.sh` so the freeze happens
BEFORE the six hooks that write emulator configs, with a shared `mad_retire_hooks` so a renamed hook
is actually removed from the deployed copy instead of running twice; `restore-library --to-live` got
the advisory `restore --to-live` already had.

**Retired**, strictly per the verified verdicts: 11 dead RPC endpoints, the `plan_selection` /
`backup_selection` planner they were the only callers of, 3 dead router CLI modes
(`splash-collection`, `view-collection`, `track-view`), 11 dead functions and 1 dead statement.
Kept on purpose: `ping`, every `guncon2_retail.*` endpoint (deliberate, test-enforced), and
`routing.xa_iface_rank`, which the audit's own scan wrongly called dead.

**Two canaries**, at ES-DE start, 55 ms total, in `mad-drift-check.sh`: EmuDeck silently un-patching
a launcher stub (detected by the `_MAD_LIB` marker, confirmed by byte-equality with EmuDeck's own
template, archived to `_TMP` and restored from git), and an emulator binary changing under MAD's
writers (a syscall-only fingerprint of every AppImage and flatpak, acknowledged with one press).

**CI lint.** ruff (F,E9,B,PLE) + shellcheck, both version-pinned, with today's 459 findings FROZEN in
`tools/lint-baseline.txt`; CI fails only when a count RISES. The B904 pattern stays by decision and
`rpc.py` now logs the underlying cause instead, so the diagnosis is in the log rather than on the
wire. Never bulk-apply F401 fixes here: the registration imports carry explicit `noqa` markers.

**Docs.** The two `deck-docs` caches merged into the tracked repo copy (plus the orphan
`eden-config.md` that lived only inside the fork), and CLAUDE.md's relative `deck-docs/` references
made absolute, which is the load-bearing half: the relative path is how two caches came to exist.
GUIDE.md refreshed against the live sidebar. Ryujinx's contradictory per-game documentation resolved
to the direct read/write model that actually ships.

### Honest corrections made during this phase

- **The launch-cost fix under-delivered and the code says so.** The `_standalone` gate was written
  expecting ps2/switch/ps3/xbox to skip a 384 ms device scan. Measured: `resolve_policy` merges a
  `category` onto every system and both console and arcade default a warning ON, so on a rig with an
  X-Arcade identified the gate almost never fires. The residual cost is not dead work, it is the
  "you have only the arcade stick plugged in" check. Two candidate real fixes are recorded at the
  gate in `controller-router.py`. Do not re-derive this: measure first.
- **A 14-agent adversarial review ran before anything was committed** and found two HIGH and eleven
  MED defects in this phase's own work, all fixed: the stub canary would have raised a permanent
  undismissable dialog once EmuDeck installed an emulator MAD never patched; `git checkout --`
  restores from the INDEX, so a staged reversion was reported as a repair that never happened; the
  emulator fingerprint fired on MAD's own self-update; a test file silently lost a class statement;
  backup-side cancellation lost its only coverage.

### Accepted risks, recorded so they are not re-raised

- **pixel-es-de stays PUBLIC** with its bundled art, decided by the owner after the licensing
  question was put plainly. Not a finding any more.
- **The ScreenScraper password rides ES-DE settings backups** (it lives in `es_settings.xml`), by
  design. GUIDE.md section 9 now says so in plain language so an archive is never shared unaware.
- **No emulator-running guard on cloud restores.** The panel IS ES-DE and both panel restore paths
  hardcode `to_live`, so an `esde_running()` guard would refuse 100% of on-screen restores; an
  emulator-only guard needs new proc_guard API plus a production bypass for the tests, and a false
  refusal (pcsx2 vs pcsx2x6 are documented mutual false positives) is worse than the advisory.

### Deferred to the NEXT fork rebuild (agreed with the owner)

1. `GamescopeFocus` recheck-on-stale, so the wrong-app focus latch recovers on its own.
2. Cap the unbounded `gamescope-focus.log` (same file, free once rebuilding).
3. Correct the C++ comments that name retired RPCs (`GuiMadPageGranularGames.h:10` is already wrong
   today, and this phase makes two more wrong).
4. A design pass on making the panel helper resident (Preview costs ~10 s per open today; the
   restart-per-open behaviour was a deliberate earlier decision, so this needs design, not a patch).

### Recorded gaps, deliberately not fixed here

- The live granular Controllers backup does not carry the `.mad-input-overrides.json` sidecar that
  the retired snapshot flow did. Recorded in `tests/test_pcsx2x6.py`.
- A panel-driven granular restore runs in-daemon, so no freeze site can signal it. Bounded: closing
  the panel destroys the backend, so it cannot outlive the panel and therefore cannot run during a
  game. GUIDE.md words it accordingly.
- `hooks/system-select/05-record-view.sh` now writes a file nobody reads (retiring it touches the
  gated-hook machinery).
- EmuDeck's `chmod +x` sweep over the clone root flips ~26 tracked files to mode 755, which
  `install.sh` then reads as local work and refuses to pull. Loud, not silent; fix shape is to make
  `_mad_real_dirt` ignore mode-only changes.
- `deck-docs/rpcs3-config-encodings.md` is cited by `lib/madsrv/rpcs3_settings.py` and was never
  written.
